Quarterly income by entity.mdx: SELECT TM1SubsetToSet([Period], 'Quarters') ON COLUMNS, {[Entity].Members} * {[Account].[Net Income], [Account].[Revenue], [Account].[Operating Expenses]} ON ROWS FROM [General Ledger] WHERE ([Version].[Actual])

Margin by month.mdx: WITH MEMBER [Account].[Margin %] AS IIF([Account].[Revenue] = 0, 0, [Account].[Net Income] / [Account].[Revenue]) SELECT NON EMPTY TM1SubsetToSet([Period], 'Months') ON COLUMNS, {[Account].[Revenue], [Account].[Net Income], [Account].[Margin %]} ON ROWS FROM [General Ledger] WHERE ([Entity].[Total Entity], [Version].[Actual])

Year to date.mdx: WITH MEMBER [Version].[Actual YTD] AS Sum(Ytd(), [Version].[Actual]) SELECT [Period].Levels('Month').Members ON COLUMNS, {[Account].[Revenue], [Account].[Operating Expenses], [Account].[Net Income]} ON ROWS FROM [General Ledger] WHERE ([Entity].[Total Entity], [Version].[Actual YTD])
